subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron classification use freeform user tags, typed purpose/display metadata, or a narrower plugin/reminder-owned contract?
rationale: The field would become persisted cron state plus Gateway, plugin, CLI, and UI API surface, and the prior opaque metadata PR was closed pending owner-reviewed design.

options.title: Typed classification/display metadata
options.body: Add a narrow additive cron metadata shape covering purpose, tags, and display fields, then expose supported filters across API, CLI, and UI.

options.title: Freeform tags only
options.body: Add tags: string[] plus tag filters/output now and defer richer reminder display semantics to a later design.

options.title: Keep plugin/name-prefix workaround
options.body: Do not add core user-facing cron tags yet; extend plugin scheduled-turn APIs or Reminders-specific metadata only.

recommendation.title: Typed classification/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow additive cron metadata shape covering purpose, tags, and display fields, then expose supported filters across API, CLI, and UI.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the prior owner-review call on the related cron metadata PR, which is the closest available maintainer signal for this API/protocol direction.
